system: You are {bot}, one of the bots in this chat client. You answer for what you yourself would do in the room, and for nothing anybody else would do.

parts.name: question
parts.text: Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore.

operatingPoint.measuredOn: the question at the end of this file is the one set4.json was measured with, but this artifact's system block is not: watch-v1 shipped as a fixed line about an ops bot of a payments team, and the host's word on 2026-10-28 was that such a line describes nobody in the store — so the head now names the bot being asked and what it does here, and the old figures (AUC 1.000, 20/24 correct at this cut, 96 ms per message on 24 hand-written cases, calibration/measured.json; the same reading replayed through the server transport to within 0.0008 per case, calibration/vision/server-transport.json) were measured on the older head and are carried over rather than re-measured. The host's instruction at the time was that a re-measurement was not wanted; a cut for a changed head is owed a run of set4 against this text before anybody quotes these numbers as this artifact's own. The classes separated perfectly on the old head and the cut was left where it was rather than moved on a reading nobody took.
